gaps.reason: ADR-0036 decision 4 is scoped to identity-less bodies: the Laravel Redis path applies the identity rule only, not the strict decoder's typed-member pass. A body with a valid job and a non-numeric attempts is still poison on Redis through the reserve script (broker-bindings.md section 1.1); the typed-member pass for the other members is a later phase.

ADR-0036 decision 4 is scoped to identity-less bodies: the Laravel Redis path applies the identity rule only, not the strict decoder's typed-member pass (a list data with a valid job and a numeric attempts is handed to the handler). The typed-member pass is a later phase.

exceptions.scope: babelqueue-* connections with the BabelQueue DLQ disabled
exceptions.behaviour: A poison body and a job whose retries are exhausted are failed into Laravel's `failed_jobs` instead of being dead-lettered (broker-bindings.md section 1.1 says a Redis poison body is dead-lettered in every configuration). With the DLQ enabled the poison body is dead-lettered as the ADR-0035 record with reason "poison".
exceptions.reason: ADR-0037 decision 4: a normative exception to the "dead-lettered in every configuration" rule (GR-6, Laravel's native failure store is the framework's quarantine). No conformance case exercises the DLQ-disabled path, so this is not a failing case and is not listed under `gaps`; this entry is informational and is not read by the known-gaps gate.

exceptions.scope: babelqueue-sqs and babelqueue-artemis, version-gated deliveries (sections version_gate_sqs and version_gate_artemis)
exceptions.behaviour: BabelQueueDispatcher::handleUnsupportedSchemaVersion() keeps its own handling: with the DLQ enabled an envelope with a `dead_letter` block (reason "poison") is published and the delivery acked, not the raw body of the ADR-0037 settle rule; with the DLQ disabled it throws InvalidEnvelopeException so the worker's retry and then `failed_jobs` take it; `on_unknown_urn` is ignored. Every case of both sections is reported as `skip` with the reason `ADR-0037 decision 4`, not as a `fail`.
exceptions.reason: ADR-0037 decision 4 (the Laravel exception extended to the version-gate path). A skip is the explicit, ADR-backed result, so these cases are not known gaps.
